Hi Prabha Dental Hospital Team,

I noticed your clinic has an exceptional 5.0★ rating with 130+ reviews in Jakkanpur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for instant appointment bookings.

Maine aapke hospital ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, painless dental treatments showcase, aur clinic timings integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/prabha

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Prabha Dental Hospital Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental hospital ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a 5-star Google review showcase, direct WhatsApp consultation booking, and mobile-first speed right opposite NIFT College in Jakkanpur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact treatments, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
